ticket_text: I am locked out of my portal due to password attempts

retrieved_documents.text:
# Password Policy

## Purpose

This policy explains how customers can recover access to their account.

## Allowed

- Provide password reset instructions.
- Explain account recovery steps.
- Direct the customer to the normal login recovery process.

## Restricted

- Do not request the customer's password.
- Do not disclose authentication secrets.
- Do not bypass account security controls.

## Escalation

Escalate the case when the customer reports suspicious account activity.

# Security Compromise Runbook

## Purpose

This runbook outlines steps for suspected security breaches.

## Allowed

- Immediately lock the affected user account.
- Direct user to change password and re-enable MFA.
- Reassure customer that the security team is investigating.

## Restricted

- Do not share forensic audit logs with the customer.
- Do not admit liability or name external attack vectors.

## Escalation

All suspected compromises are critical and must be escalated to SecOps immediately.
